item.title: Rallying Cry – June 21, 2026
item.description: Curacao’s record-equalling keeper made history, Germany’s factory-to-World-Cup super-sub Undav stole the show, water prices will stay frozen in Queensland, and we’re celebrating the women running businesses under Taliban rule.
